# Solana Developer Platform

> Public documentation and API discovery resources for Solana Developer Platform.

## Canonical URLs
- Docs: https://platform.solana.com/docs
- API: https://api.solana.com
- API reference: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api
- OpenAPI: https://api.solana.com/openapi.json
- AI guide: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/docs-for-ai

## Supported surfaces
- Token issuance and lifecycle operations
- Wallets and custody
- API key management and projects
- Payments, transfers, and recurring payments
- Fiat on-ramps and off-ramps
- DeFi and RWA strategies, customer-signed transactions, and positions
- Compliance screening
- Asset profiles and public token metadata

## Public endpoint families
- Health: https://api.solana.com/health
- Wallets: https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets
- Projects: https://api.solana.com/v1/projects
- Issuance: https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance
- Payments: https://api.solana.com/v1/payments
- Compliance: https://api.solana.com/v1/compliance
- Counterparties: https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties
- Asset Profiles: https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance
- Earn: https://api.solana.com/v1/earn

## Start here
- [What is SDP?](https://platform.solana.com/docs/introduction): One API for building on Solana with your chosen providers, from devnet to mainnet.
- [Set up your workspace](https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/setup-organization): Create your account and organization, which comes with a Sandbox and a Production project.
- [Create a wallet](https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/setup-wallets): Set up a custody provider and create wallets for signing transactions.
- [Go to mainnet](https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/go-to-mainnet): Request mainnet access, connect your own custody account, and go live.
- [Manage API Keys](https://platform.solana.com/docs/developing-with-sdp/manage-api-keys): Create, rotate, and revoke API keys with explicit grants by module, a signing wallet scope, and zero-downtime rotation.
- [Tokenize an Asset](https://platform.solana.com/docs/tokens/tokenize-an-asset): Map a real-world asset to the right SDP token model, authorities, and implementation flow.
- [Create a Token](https://platform.solana.com/docs/tokens/create-a-token): Define a new token using a template or custom configuration.
- [Deploy a Token](https://platform.solana.com/docs/tokens/deploy-a-token): Deploy a created token to the Solana blockchain.
- [Mint and Burn](https://platform.solana.com/docs/tokens/mint-and-burn): Increase or decrease token supply by minting to an address or burning from an account you control.
- [Payments](https://platform.solana.com/docs/payments): Send, accept and reconcile Solana payments from your SDP custody wallets.
- [Basic payment](https://platform.solana.com/docs/payments/send-basic-payment): Send one token transfer from a custody wallet to a Solana address, from the dashboard or the API.
- [Tokenization Templates](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/issuance-token-types): How to choose a token template, and the default controls each one applies.
- [End-to-end Payment Flow](https://platform.solana.com/docs/tutorials/end-to-end-payment-flow): Send a payment from wallet setup through settlement and reconciliation.
- [Infrastructure Provider Onboarding](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/provider-onboarding): Add an infrastructure provider integration to SDP through the self-service contribution process.
- [AI resources](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/docs-for-ai): Machine-readable SDP docs, the agent skill, and setup for coding agents.
- [API conventions](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/conventions): What every SDP API call has in common, from how it authenticates to how it fails.
- [Postman Collection](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/postman-collection): Download the public SDP API as a Postman collection, generated from the OpenAPI contract.
- [API Reference](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api): Choose an API family to explore its endpoints.
- [Health](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/health): Service health and readiness endpoints.
- [Wallets](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets): Wallet signing provider configuration and wallet management.
- [Projects](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/projects): Projects and their provider availability. Project members and keys are managed in the dashboard.
- [Issuance](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance): Token issuance, allowlists, and lifecycle operations.
- [Payments](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments): Wallet balances, transfers, and payment flows.
- [Compliance](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/compliance): Risk and compliance screening endpoints.
- [Counterparties](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties): A counterparty is a person or business you pay or get paid by. You save their details and payment accounts once, then reuse them in payments.
- [Asset Profiles](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles): Issued-asset identity and metadata profiles, plus the public token metadata URI.
- [Earn](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn): Strategy reads, previews, withdrawal-route discovery, unsigned builds, submission, queued actions, and tenant tracking. Availability follows the deployment's release channel.
- [Earn](https://platform.solana.com/docs/earn): Offer stablecoin yield in your app, from your customers' own wallets, through one API.
- [Quickstart](https://platform.solana.com/docs/earn/quickstart): Make a sandbox deposit with three API requests and one wallet signature.
- [How Earn works](https://platform.solana.com/docs/earn/concepts): Who signs, who holds funds, how one integration serves many customers, what it costs, and how movements settle.
- [Embedded Yield](https://platform.solana.com/docs/guides/embedded-yield): Build customer-signed deposits, balances, and withdrawals into your app, from first request to go-live.

## AI guide
- [Docs for AI](https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/docs-for-ai): Human-readable landing page for machine-readable SDP docs resources, usage guidance, and public AI scope.

## Machine-readable resources
- [llms.txt](https://platform.solana.com/docs/ai/llms.txt)
- [llms-full.txt](https://platform.solana.com/docs/ai/llms-full.txt)
- [SKILL.md](https://platform.solana.com/SKILL.md): Agent skill with the rules for building on SDP.
- Any docs page as Markdown: add `.md` to its URL.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.solana.com/openapi.json)

## Scope
- Public AI artifacts intentionally exclude hidden or internal-only API families.
